description: This file defines a React component and related utility functions for managing and displaying notifications within a UI. It includes functions for error handling, message normalization, and presenting notifications based on various application states and error messages, primarily using the 'antd' notification system.

methods.name: defaultPlacement
methods.description: Returns the default placement for notifications, set to 'topRight'.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes input into a NotificationConfigResolved object, assigning fallback message if necessary.

methods.name: toIntMaybe
methods.description: Attempts to parse a value to an integer if possible.

methods.name: titleFor
methods.description: Determines the notification title based on status code and message content, matching against predefined error categories.

methods.name: extractStatus
methods.description: Extracts HTTP or API response status code from various input formats.

methods.name: extractDescription
methods.description: Extracts and formats an error message or description from different input object structures.

methods.name: looksErrorPayload
methods.description: Checks if the input appears to be an error payload based on its structure and content.

methods.name: classifyGeneralMessage
methods.description: Classifies a message into success, warning, or info based on content matches.
